mil7.3.3:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, bījassa dve angāni gahetabbānīti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni dve angāni gahetabbānīti.
mil7.3.3:1.2: Yathā mahārāja bījaṃ appakam-pi samānaṃ bhaddake khette vuttaṃ deve sammā dhāraṃ pavecchante subahūni phalāni anudassati,
mil7.3.3:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena yathā paṭipāditaṃ sīlaṃ kevalaṃ sāmaññaphalam-anudassati
mil7.3.3:1.5: Idaṃ mahārāja bījassa paṭhamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.3.3:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja bījaṃ suparisodhite khette ropitaṃ khippam-eva saṃvirūhati,
mil7.3.3:2.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena mānasaṃ supariggahītaṃ suññāgāre parisodhitaṃ satipaṭṭhāna-khettavare khittaṃ khippameva virūhati.
mil7.3.3:2.3: Idaṃ mahārāja bījassa dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
